note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000 (gameplay mapping). Belgium was an EU member state (free trade inside the single market) with a social market economy and strong social partners. Conscription is set to volunteer force: the Belgian Armed Forces article gives conscription as suspended since 1992. Energy is set to energy mix: nuclear power supplied a large share of electricity (about half in later years) and the phase-out law came only in 2003 (Wikipedia: Nuclear power in Belgium). Healthcare is social insurance: compulsory social security covers health care, with mutual societies handling reimbursements (Wikipedia: Healthcare in Belgium). Religion and state is set to pluralist secularism (gameplay judgement).
